en.text: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

footnotes.text: 1:2 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

en.text: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

zhSimplified.text: 他要像一棵树栽在溪水旁，

zhTraditional.text: 他要像一棵樹栽在溪水旁，

en.text: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

zhSimplified.text: 因此，当审判的时候、恶人必站立不住；

zhTraditional.text: 因此，當審判的時候，惡人必站立不住；

en.text: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华知道义人的道路；

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華知道義人的道路；
